invariants.rationale: The return value from the execute() method (and thus upsertPrepped) is expected to be a valid HoodieWriteMetadata object.
instantTime is supplied directly to the JavaUpsertPreppedDeltaCommitActionExecutor and is critical for correct execution; method likely assumes it is non-null.
preppedRecords is passed to the action executor for upsert, so null would probably cause a failure or is not supported.
context is cast to HoodieJavaEngineContext and is required for execution, so it likely must not be null.
The HoodieWriteMetadata returned should contain a non-null List of WriteStatus objects.
